items.title: Ms Usha Gopal
items.quote:
I’m happy to share my publication certificate for my first research publication as the 3rd Co-Author.
📖 Topic: “AI-Generated Radiology Reports: Opportunities for Efficiency, Diagnostic Support, and Risks to Patient Safety”
A special thanks to Zakir Hussain Parray for his valuable support, guidance, and encouragement throughout this journey. 🙏
Grateful for this opportunity and excited to continue my journey in research, radiography, and medical imaging. ✨
